entities.name: José Manuel Rodrigues
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: José M. Rodrigues, born as José Manuel dos Santos Rodrigues, is a contemporary Portuguese-Dutch photographer and visual artist. He lives and works since 1993 in Évora, Portugal, after more than twenty years living and working in the Netherlands.
